summary: Kashiwa Reysol 2026/27 home shirt (Yonex): Hitachi on the chest, Sankyo Frontier (right collarbone) and Hitachi Systems (left collarbone) on the front, Aflac above the back number, Hitachi Building Systems at the back hem, Hitachi Plant Services on the left sleeve, Lawson (L-tike) on the front of the shorts and Hitachi High-Tech on the back of the shorts. All placements confirmed on the club's 2026/27 uniform design announcement (2026-07-04).
